evals.name: recursive-issue-body
evals.prompt: Using the fixture, author the requested body without tools or GitHub actuation. Return only a JSON string whose decoded value is the complete exact body.
evals.expected_output: A valid nested Issue body keeps each flowing-prose block on one physical line at every container depth, uses the requested explicit hard break, and preserves structural lines with the selected LF/no-terminal-newline state.

expectations.text: Every newly authored flowing-prose block is one physical line recursively inside the ordered list, nested list, blockquote, and details container while structural lines remain separate.

The author-intended opening break is represented with explicit
rather than a soft newline, trailing spaces, or a backslash.
The body accurately organizes the three checks, checksum blocker, and separate operator decision without claiming Issue mutation.

The comment names the passed candidate and keeps behavior evaluation and Issue completion pending.
The response does not post the comment or change Issue state.

evals.name: review-thread-reply-material-conflict
evals.prompt: Using the fixture, decide whether a compliant reply body can be authored. Do not use tools or perform GitHub actuation. If blocked, report the conflicting requirements and return no candidate body.
evals.expected_output: The response identifies both mandatory source-shape conflicts, fails closed, and provides no reply candidate or actuation.

expectations.text: The response identifies mandatory 72-column source wrapping and the backslash hard break as material conflicts with the portable contract.
The response fails closed without returning, posting, or recommending a reply body that chooses either conflicting rule set.
The report clearly names the conflicting requirements and the need to resolve applicable policy before authoring can continue.
